data.long_meaning: In Celtic mythology, Merline is derived from the name Merlin, a wise and powerful sorcerer. The name Merline is believed to evoke the image of a sea maiden, who is both mysterious and enchanting. The name Merline carries the meaning “Sea Maiden” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Merline usually hope their child will grow to embody sea maiden and live with faith, good character and purpose.
